notes.title: Whirlight is at PAX East starting today!
notes.notes:
We made it to Boston. The bags arrived, the booth is standing, and yes, we remembered the demo.

From today through May 11, you can find us at booth 13097 at PAX East. If you're attending, come say hi. Play Whirlight, meet the team, and step into this strange little world we’ve been building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/b72a1352ff02ee7eeff6acf0472989e3e0a0eba2.png[/img]

Whether you've been with us from the start or you're just getting curious, we’d love to see you in person and hear what you think.

Not at the show? No problem. You can still play the Whirlight demo right here on Steam. Your feedback and support mean everything to us. Also, check out PAX East official event on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/paxeast2025


👉 Try the demo and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/

Thanks for being part of the journey!

notes.title: Whirlight joins Indie Assemble on Steam!
notes.notes:
From May 5 to 11, Whirlight: No Time To Trip is part of Indie Assemble, a massive celebration of indie games on Steam. Over 1,000 titles from more than 600 studios are coming together for one global showcase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/a2f5fa10aac739dbab7faaf8181ebc3b49700da0.jpg[/img]

Our demo is live and ready to play. If you enjoy quirky sci-fi, hand-drawn point-and-clicks, or time travel that definitely does not go as planned, you might feel right at home in Whirlight.

🎮 Try the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737/sale/IndieAssemble

No pressure, no timers, just a good excuse to play something different. We're thrilled to stand alongside developers from 63 countries and celebrate the creativity of indie games together.

Thanks to Excaliber and Steam for making it happen. Explore, discover, and support indie teams like ours.

notes.title: Whirlight: No Time to Trip – New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers!

We’ve been hard at work, and thanks to your incredible feedback, we’re excited to bring you a freshly updated demo for Whirlight: No Time to Trip! 🎉 That’s right—Hector’s adventures just got a whole lot smoother, and we’ve thrown in some awesome new features, plus a brand-new location for you to explore!

🚀 Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] 🏃 Run on double-click—because sometimes even a time-traveling genius is in a hurry!
[*] 📜 Mark conversations you’ve already read—no more accidental deja vu.
[*] 🎨 Fresh new cursors for that extra bit of style.
[*] 💾 Updated saving/loading UI—so sleek, Hector might even approve!
[*] 🐞 And of course, we’ve squashed some pesky bugs.
[/list]

[b]⚠️ Heads-up: The new run feature works only with a new game, not with saves from the previous demo version. So, why not give it a fresh start and enjoy the latest tweaks?[/b]

But wait, there’s more! 🌟 We're working on a brand-new location and here's a little sneak peek!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/37b05948b7a03f57e66bb9a871bb984f6e834f1d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Whirlight on its way ti the DevGAMM Awards! 🚀 Cast Your Vote Now!
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers!

We’ve got some BIG news! 🎉 Whirlight: No Time to Trip will participate to the DevGAMM Awards – and now, we need YOUR help to win the Community Vote! 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/4606c5d000b95f7ff5aac9866506d988ab03c1a6.png[/img]

You’ve moved your first steps into Hector and Margaret's time-bending adventures, and now it’s time to take them to the next level! This is your chance to support their (and our) mission to greatness!

Here’s the deal: we’ve been working hard to bring you a point-and-click adventure that’s full of everything we love about the genre. We spent years playing adventure games as kids and now are getting a shot at making them as full-grown adults! 

Now, with your help, we can take home the DevGAMM Community Vote award! 💥
[b]
👉 Cast your vote here: [url=https://form.fillout.com/t/hZWP7Kgy7Aus]Vote for Whirlight[/url]
🗓️ Voting deadline: October 27, so don’t wait![/b]

🚀 Why should you vote for Whirlight?

You should if you really liked what you saw so far. We put our passion and expertise into the making of this game, hoping that you all would enjoy playing it as much as we did making it.
As a small, indipendent team self publishing our own game, we will accept all the support our community can give to continue working on it: [b]your vote could make all the difference! [/b]

🔔 Don’t forget to wishlist Whirlight on Steam and stay tuned for more news on our adventure-packed journey! 🚀

Thank you for all your support so far, and let’s get those votes in for Hector, Margaret, and the whole Whirlight crew!

Vote now, adventure later! 🥳

notes.title: Whirlight - No Time To Trip Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers!

[h2][b]Whirlight - No Time to Trip's Demo is now live![/b] [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/93f18d8f5439d97203ec80f5b2dd0c009b017277.jpg[/img]

Step into the shoes of Hector, our quirky middle-aged scientist whose luck is as peculiar as his inventions. Alongside Margaret, a strong and determined artist, you'll explore the charming Verice Bay, journey through time, and meet an array of bizarre characters.

Whirlight - No Time to Trip is a [b]point-and-click adventure[/b] that captures the spirit of classic games like "Day of the Tentacle" and "Sam & Max Hit the Road," with its whimsical humor, hand-drawn graphics, and engaging story. From the acclaimed developers of "[b]Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town[/b]," this game promises a unique and unforgettable experience.

What's in the demo?

[list]
[*] [b]Dive into the early chapters[/b] of Hector and Margaret's adventure.
[*] Experience the vibrant, cartoony atmosphere and witty dialogue.
[*] Get a taste of the time-traveling mechanics and puzzle-solving fun.
[/list]

🚀 Play the demo now and join Hector's extraordinary journey!

🌟 We're also excited to announce our participation in the [b]Adventure Game Fan Fair on July 26-28.[/b] While we won't be attending in person, we'll be connecting with players on-site, sharing insights, and answering your burning questions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/564eba86c882f766fc2fe5351c5b861cafc3a289.jpg[/img]


🔔 Don't forget to [b]wishlist Whirlight: No Time to Trip[/b] to stay updated on the latest news and developments. Your support helps us bring this adventure to life!

🎉 Join our community! Be part of the conversation and share your experiences with fellow adventurers on our Discord server [[url=https://discord.gg/vyxA5Mmm52]Join Here[/url]]. Your feedback is invaluable to us!

Thank you for being a part of this whimsical journey. We can't wait to hear about your adventures in Verice Bay!

If you like our demo, please consider supporting us with a wishlist! Happy adventuring!

[url=https://discord.gg/vyxA5Mmm52]Join our Discord server[/url] and be part of the community!

notes.title: Whirlight: No Time to Trip - Adventure Game Fan Fair & Closed Beta out (soon)!
notes.notes:
Hello there adventurers!

We’ve got some nice news for you that we're exicted to share!

First off, we will be bringing Whirlight: No Time To Trip to the Adventure Game Fan Fair!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/564eba86c882f766fc2fe5351c5b861cafc3a289.jpg[/img]


Mark your calendars, grab your adventure hats, and buckle up for the Adventure Game Fan Fair in Tacoma from July 26th to 28th! While we can’t be there in person (we're sending our digital love from afar), we’re thrilled to announce that [b]our spiffy new demo will be on display[/b] at the University of Washington, Tacoma. Swing by and get a sneak peek of our work in progress!

For all the deets on the Fan Fair, check out [url=https://adventuregamefanfair.com/]their official page here.[/url]

But wait, there’s more! 🚀

We’re on the hunt for some brave souls to dive into the mysterious, whimsical, and slightly bonkers world of Whirlight before anyone else. That’s right, we’re launching a closed beta, and we want YOU to be a part of it! Join our Discord server to toss your name in the hat for a chance to play the game before it goes public.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/5c3eb415bc459855a1fb84d75e2292701bc8f83e.jpg[/img]

Our closed beta comes with a fancy-schmancy NDA (that’s a Non-Disclosure Agreement, but it sounds cooler abbreviated, right?). So, you’ll get to be all secretive and mysterious about your early access to our game. Think of it as your own little spy mission... but with fewer car chases and more bug reporting.

Join the fun on our Discord server here: [url=https://discord.com/invite/F3HGZz2aCe]Whirlight Discord[/url]

So, ready to trip the light fantastic and help us make Whirlight the best adventure game it can be? We knew you’d be up for the challenge!

See you on Discord, brave adventurers! 😉

Happy adventuring!

The imaginarylab Team 🌟

notes.title: Announcing - Whirlight: No Time to Trip
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, adventurers, artists, mad scientists and everyone in-between![/b]
We're thrilled to unveil [b]Whirlight: No Time to Trip[/b], an out-of-this-world point-and-click odyssey that'll tickle your funny bone and tease your brain cells! 🌌✨

[previewyoutube=ax11NPeMmBg;full][/previewyoutube]

🔍 [b]Meet Hector, Our Quirky Prodigy![/b]
Prepare to embark on a cosmic journey with Hector, the eccentric middle-aged scientist whose every invention hilariously backfires. But fear not – his misfortunes are about to become your source of endless entertainment! 😅🔬

🚀 [b]Epic Adventures Through Space and Time![/b]
Join Hector and his companion, the spirited artist Margaret, in exploring the whimsical Verice Bay. Just when they think they've cracked the code to Hector's success, they're catapulted into a mind-bending adventure! ⏳🌈

🎨 [b]A Universe of Humor and Fantasy![/b]
Immerse yourself in a universe where humor, fantasy, and time travel converge seamlessly. The hand-drawn graphics will transport you to a vibrant world reminiscent of classics like "Day of the Tentacle" and "Sam & Max Hit the Road." Get ready for a color explosion and dialogues so hilarious they might just break the space-time continuum! 🌍😂

🌟 [b]From the Developers of Willy Morgan![/b]
For those who enjoyed the brilliance of Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town, brace yourselves for another masterpiece from the same developers. Your favorite gaming maestros are back with a concoction of chaos, brilliance, and laughter! 🎮🤹‍♂️

🛒 [b]Wishlist NOW, Thank Us Later![/b]
Don't miss the chance to be part of the adventure. Hit that wishlist button on Steam to secure your seat on the time-travel rollercoaster! 🎢✨

🚀 [b]Connect with Whirlight on Social Media![/b]
Talk to us, ask things, look at our time-traveling memes, and get exclusive updates! Follow us on:

[url=https://twitter.com/whirlightgame]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/Whirlight]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Whirlightgame/]Reddit[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/vyxA5Mmm52]Discord[/url]

[b]Get ready for a whirlwind of laughter, adventure, and maybe a mischievous time-traveling parrot! [/b]
